notes.title: Castle Chaos -66% Sale!
notes.notes:
Prepare for richer chaos at a cheaper price!

Castle Chaos is now available at a 66% discount, grab a few friends and experience a chaotic medieval battle, hopefully you will still be friends afterwards!

Players have voted for an online multiplayer feature and we are glad to announce that we are working on it at full speed, so it will come with the next update.

To vote on new features visit our website here:
[url=http://www.oddcometgames.com/#/game/castlechaos]www.oddcometgames.com[/url]

notes.title: New update and xmas sale -33%!
notes.notes:
We've added the most upvoted feature "Team-play" to Castle Chaos.
Now you can play 2 vs 2, 3 vs 1, mix AI-bots and human players.

A much requested feature was "Online play" so now we have added this feature to the list for you to vote on.

Here is the complete list of future features:
oddcometgames.com/#/game/castlechaos

So check out what we have in store and vote on the features you feel are the most important.
